description:
Title: Drupal Developer 
 Location: Columbus, IN 
 Duration: 6 to 12 months
 Interview: Phone and Skype
 
 Job description:- 
 · Certified on Acquia Certified Developer Core 
 · Basic understanding of Acquia Cloud Site Factory (ACSF) environment is required
 · Experience in Drupal 7 and Drupal 8 platforms is must
 · Working knowledge of GIT 
 · Good understanding of the newest Drupal 7 features and modules like multi language variation sites, taxonomy, design packages and building B2B sites
 · Practical experience with the following languages/applications/frameworks is required : PHP, MySQL, HTML5, CSS3, JQuery, Bootstrap, AJAX, XML, Web-Services
 · Knowledge of the Drupal backend and Core. Ability to create custom modules
 · Good understanding of Drupal Forms and Modules (both core and contributed)
 · SEO knowledge to improve search, through the use of URL path configuration, and configure faceted search and external search engine integrations like Apache SOLR
 · Strong experience in Drupal Layout and Theming. Ability to create customize layouts and themes. Help to implement best practices for sustainable theming
 · Ability to implement Drupal core database abstraction layer
 · Drupal UX Changes and Responsive design
 · Employ and articulate best practices, security techniques, conventions and coding standards
 · Employ contexts and variants for a control over display of content depending on context such as page or user role
 · MySQL and Oracle DB knowledge
 · Good experience in DB data structure definition
 · Desired years of experience : 6 to 9 years
 · Education/ Certifications (Required) : B.E or Btech
 · Troubleshooting activities for ACSF environment in co-ordination with Acquia and managing deployments – merge code, resolve merge conflicts, deploy code on environments
 · Best practices review and support process improvements for Drupal CMS
 · Oversee new initiatives for Drupal within GWC. Understanding of Drupal 7 and Drupal 8 features is must

 Graduate 


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
